title: Barcelona target two signings as part of Flick’s defensive rebuild in 2027 – report
tweet: Flick’s 2027 defensive rebuild focuses first on a centre‑back in January, then on a full‑back in the summer, as Barça look for a physically imposing partner for Cubarsi and a reliable right‑back to replace Kounde. As things stand, both signings remain unconfirmed and will hinge on market depth and contract terms.

title: Opponent watch: Atletico Madrid winger set to miss La Liga clash against Barcelona
tweet: Ademola Lookman will miss the 2 December home clash with Atletico after a high‑grade knee sprain; the absence removes a key threat that proved decisive in last season’s cup and European run, giving Barça a tactical edge as they seek a title‑deciding win.

title: Deco leaves door open to Barcelona signing a centre-back in January, rules out youngster’s exit
tweet: Deco says a Jan centre‑back slot remains on the table after a rash of injuries, but he rules out Balde’s exit for now. As things stand, the squad has depth, yet the window is still a contingency.

title: Barcelona director Deco reveals the player he regrets missing out on the most
tweet: Deco names Luis Diaz as the biggest miss of his tenure. The Colombian’s pace and versatility fit Barça’s attack, but financial limits blocked the deal. As things stand, the club still lacks a natural No. 9.

title: Three possible destinations for Alejandro Balde amid uncertain future at Barcelona
tweet: Balde has logged only 124 minutes in five games, yet Barcelona still list a €40 million price tag. Manchester United offer a straight sporting fit, Juventus propose a six‑month loan to give him game time, and Roma would need a lower fee or wage split. As things stand, the club’s financial demand remains the biggest hurdle.
